messages:
Alice: Kicking off staggered rollout for v2.3.1 now. Change window 01:00-03:00 UTC. Plan: heat to 1% -> 5% -> 10% over ~30m. Stop/go in 5m for ops + SRE check. Please ack and flag any concerns.

DeployBot: Rollout job started.
```
release: v2.3.1
strategy: staged
steps:
  - pct: 1
    duration: 5m
  - pct: 5
    duration: 15m
  - pct: 10
    duration: 10m
pin_if_errors: 5
monitoring: infra+latency+errors
```
Targets: api-prod, edge-proxy-eu
Current: 1% (at ~00:02 elapsed)

Ben: Acked. Release notes posted to #release-notes — link: <https://redwood/internal/release/v2.3.1>. No breaking changes called out.

Paul (SRE): Looking at infra dashboards — most systems green but seeing a small 503 blip on canary at +3m, rate ~0.4% (5xx). Digging into edge-proxy logs now.

Maria: Quick note from model-evals: rolldata regression ~2.1% on a small prompt slice (low freq). Not yet huge but worth watching during ramp.

Tim: Suggest holding at 1% until we confirm the 503 blip source. If it's transient infra we can continue; if it ties to model variant, better to pin.

Alice: Good call. Hold for now. DeployBot, pause rollout.

DeployBot: Rollout paused at 1%. Reason: manual hold by Alice. No automatic rollback triggered.

Ben: On it — I'll pin eu-west traffic to v2.2.9 as a safety fallback while SRE investigates. Running: `kctl traffic pin api-prod eu-west --to v2.2.9 --reason "canary 503/quality check"`

Paul (SRE): If you pin, remember to flush KV cache on edge-proxy to avoid stale routing entries. Command: `infractl kv flush edge-proxy-eu`.

Ben: Pinned to v2.2.9 for eu-west, starting KV flush now. ETA ~2m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

DeployBot: KV flush job started. Status: in-progress. Rollout remains paused.

Maria: After pin, I re-ran the small eval; regression disappears on pinned traffic (looks like rollout variant issue). Posting logs in thread.

Paul (SRE): Edge 503s correlated with a new proxy filter introduced in v2.3.1 routing layer. Suspect header handling mismatch. Good catch.

Alice: OK — we will not proceed until fix is merged and canary validated. Ben, keep pin in place. Tim, coordinate with infra on the proxy filter rollback/patch. Re-open when we have a validated build.

Ben: KV flush complete, pinned and confirmed. :white_check_mark:

DeployBot: Rollout paused (manual). Current live: v2.2.9 pinned in eu-west, 1% canary held.

Alice: Thanks all — incident-free hold. Will schedule a follow-up preflight when fix is ready.
